description: This file defines mock classes for USB device interface in a test framework, using Google Mock. It includes mock methods for device registration, retrieval, driver binding, and notification handling.

classes.name: USBDeviceMock
classes.description: Mock implementation of IUSBDevice interface for testing purposes.

classes.name: USBDeviceNotificationMock
classes.description: Mock implementation of IUSBDevice::INotification interface for testing device notifications.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Mocks registration of a notification callback.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Mocks deregistration of a notification callback.

methods.name: GetDeviceList
methods.description: Mocks retrieval of current USB devices list.

methods.name: GetDeviceInfo
methods.description: Mocks retrieval of specific device information.

methods.name: BindDriver
methods.description: Mocks binding a driver to a device.

methods.name: UnbindDriver
methods.description: Mocks unbinding a driver from a device.
